summary: Iteration 68 (Revenue/Income tab + net_profit + asset-category fix) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed — GET/POST/DELETE /api/revenue all correct (paid status creates both sales_invoice + payment; unpaid creates only invoice; empty body → 400; sales role gets 403; owner/finance allowed). /api/ledger/summary returns revenue_billed / revenue_received / revenue_outstanding / sales_count / net_profit. /api/ledger/ai/revenue and /api/ledger/ai/brief both return 200 JSON. guess_asset_category correctly maps network switch/firewall/rack/CCTV → 'IT & Electronics', CNC lathe → 'Machinery', van → 'Vehicle', chairs → 'Furniture'. Frontend: /ledger shows new Revenue tab between Overview and Expenses; KPI cards for Billed/Received/Outstanding, AI Analysis panel (scope=revenue), Sales & Service Invoices table with rows + per-row delete, Add Income dialog with title/amount/status/customer/save fields all opening and saving successfully. Overview tab KPI row shows Revenue, Total Spend, Net Profit (green), Received, Asset value, Inventory Value.
critical_code_review_comments: income-status is a native <select> (not shadcn Select) — works fine functionally but automated tests must set value via native change event rather than opening a menu. Consider migrating to shadcn Select for consistency with other dialogs.
Revenue KPI wrapper uses single data-testid='ledger-revenue' rather than per-card testids; not blocking but per-card testids (ledger-revenue-billed/received/outstanding) would make future QA easier.
